findings.title: Direct external provider calls bypassing model router in emergency alert summary

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini and call_mistral via GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY environment variables instead of model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM invocations through the central model router rather than directly invoking provider APIs.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes rate limiting, fallback handling, observability, and authentication policies.
